implementation_notes: Read-only public guest inspection. Pinnacle states guest odds are delayed. No account actions, sign-in, selections, or bets.

Clicking Player Props button changes #all to #player-props and renders expanded prop panels. Click title to collapse; collapsed wrapper keeps data-collapsed=true but removes collapse-content completely. Show All restores panels.
Outcome aria-label says Money Line even on prop outcomes. Market type/player must be derived from enclosing panel title and outcome label, not aria-label.

Displayed decimal and aria American prices are separately observed representations, not guaranteed exact equivalent. Example 1.645 corresponds mathematically to approximately -155.03876, while aria-label is -155; 2.230 corresponds to +123 exactly. Do not concatenate decimal and American values as two prices or double-count outcomes.
Use stable semantic attributes and collapse-title/collapse-content/market-btn hooks where possible; hashed class suffixes and event numeric IDs are not promised stable.

Parentheses, suffixes and units belong to parser tests: Over 0.5 Bases, Over 0.5 Home Runs, Over 3.5 Strikeouts, Over 3.5 Hits Allowed, Over 11.5 Pitching Outs; player market title contains full player name plus Total category.
